scope: Source-specific descriptive observations; no numeric cross-source merging

private_employment.unit: employee count, seasonally adjusted, private sector
private_employment.classification: NACE Rev2 section J, six NA88 divisions 58-63
private_employment.method: Sum exactly one row for each NA88 division 58,59,60,61,62,63; no occupational mapping.
private_employment.quality_gate: PRELIMINARY: sector mapping checked; revision and ODbL product gates pending

dpae.unit: DPAE declarations for CDI and CDD >1 month, seasonally adjusted
dpae.classification: NA38 JA (editing/audio-visual), JB (telecom), JC (IT); three components of NACE J
dpae.method: Sum exactly 3 NA38 components times 2 nonoverlapping contract types, no 2025 periods
dpae.quality_gate: PRELIMINARY: first-vintage descriptive only; not actual hires and not net employment

ai_adoption.indicator_label: Enterprises using at least one of the AI technologies: AI_TTM, AI_TSR, AI_TNLG, AI_TIR, AI_TML, AI_TPA, AI_TAR, E_AI_TPVSG
ai_adoption.unit: % enterprises using at least one AI technology
ai_adoption.population: Enterprises with 10+ persons employed in NACE Rev2 section J, France; survey sample, not all employers
ai_adoption.comparability_warning: 2025 AI technology basket adds generative image/video/audio category vs prior years; do not interpret 2024-2025 difference as same-definition growth without official bridge.
ai_adoption.quality_gate: SURVEY_DESCRIPTION_ONLY: no inference on automation, job losses or firm productivity
ai_adoption.change_2024_vs_2023_gate: REVIEW_REQUIRED: 2023 source flag b (break in series); 2023-2024 change not validated; arithmetic difference is not proof of comparability

limitations: Urssaf employment and DPAE come from one administrative family, not independent causal replications.
Eurostat ICT adoption is an enterprise survey covering 10+ persons and NACE J, not employment or occupational exposure.
Insee tertiary marchand is broader than NACE J; it cannot substitute for an independent ICT headcount.
Indeed technical occupations do not equal NACE J employers; no crosswalk has been approved.
2025 DPAE are withheld due to published contract-duration error warnings.
Eurostat E_AI_TANY AI technology basket expanded in 2025 to include generating image/video/sound; 2025 level is not strict like-for-like adoption change.
Information and communication covers publishing, media and telecoms, not just software firms.
ODbL 1.0: attribution and derivative-database obligations; commercial product review not complete.
Eurostat E_AI_TANY NACE J FR 2023 carries b (break in series); 2023-2024 comparison remains under review, not an approved trend.
